mapper.select: SELECT tab.* FROM ( (SELECT t.id AS 'objectId', t.name AS 'objectName', 10 AS 'objectType' FROM zt_task t WHERE 1 = 1 AND t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{objectName}, '%') AND ( 1 = 2 OR ${item} = #{account} AND ${item} BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}) LIMIT 10) UNION (SELECT b.id AS 'objectId', b.title AS 'objectName', 20 AS 'objectType' FROM zt_bug b WHERE 1 = 1 AND b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{objectName}, '%') AND ( 1 = 2 OR ${item} = #{account} AND ${item} BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}) LIMIT 10) UNION (SELECT s.id AS 'objectId', s.title AS 'objectName', 30 AS 'objectType' FROM zt_story s WHERE 1 = 1 AND s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{objectName}, '%') AND ( 1 = 2 OR ${item} = #{account} AND ${item} BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}) LIMIT 10) UNION (SELECT c.id AS 'objectId', c.title AS 'objectName', 40 AS 'objectType' FROM zt_case c WHERE 1 = 1 AND c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{objectName}, '%') AND ( 1 = 2 OR ${item} = #{account} AND ${item} BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}) LIMIT 10) ) tab
